title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1982-04-12
lineage: Dat (Sony D8) -> VX Pocket 440 -> Sharp MV10 -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a spellbinding show with a smoking Peggy‑O, Sugaree, Stella Blue and a blazing Sugar Magnolia.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers rave about the performance – highlighting Peggy‑O, Estimated Prophet, Sugaree, Stella Blue, Uncle John’s Band, The Other One and an especially fiery Sugar Magnolia.  The new soundboard source is praised as a huge upgrade over the old low‑end audience tape, delivering clear, full‑frequency audio with no noticeable flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: All three detailed reviews are enthusiastic (4–5 stars) and note both a high‑energy, musically strong show and an excellent soundboard recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, full‑range soundboard; reviewers mention it vastly improves on the old audience tape and note no dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, cohesive flow with seamless segues; the second set is described as hot and energetic.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Had a brief wobble finding his legs after the set break but settled in nicely for the second set.
band_member_comments.Bob: Notable vocal utterances during The Other One.
